messages:
maria: Heads-up — we need a single, owner-mapped acceptance checklist for the production cutover next week (pilot -> public). Itemizing the non-negotiables so we can sign off: SLA targets, billing backstop, docs + SDK examples, oncall rota, telemetry dashboards, and rollback criteria. Who owns each?

alex: I can take SLA & rollout policy. Proposed targets: 99.9% p99 latency <= 450ms for small requests, 99.95% availability. Billing backstop: a soft-credit window for pilot customers for first 72h if we exceed cost threshold. Need finops to confirm credit mechanics.

sam: I'll own telemetry and smoke dashboards. Need clarity on the exact metrics: per-route token cost, p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate by model, cache hit ratio, and queue depth. Also want a canary export for customer Acme so we can compare baseline.

jess: Docs status: landing page + quickstart are done. Still missing: SDK snippet for pagination and streaming examples, and the operator runbook (runbook is draft). I can finish operator runbook by Tue if reviewers unblock.

maria: Great. Alex, can you add the SLA acceptance test plan? We should include a simple script for local smoke: run 1000 requests at production distribution and assert p99 etc. Sam — please publish an observability playbook that maps alerts -> pager thresholds.

alex: Draft SLA test snippet below (I'll push to the QA repo):

```
# run 1k concurrent requests with production prompt mix
./smoke_test --routes default,embed --rps 200 --duration 10m | tee smoke.log
# assert p99 latency
python tools/assert_latency.py --log smoke.log --p99 0.45
```

alex: Also we should explicitly allow a fallback model tier for degraded performance: route to a cheaper quantized variant automatically when queue depth > 50. That needs to be listed under acceptance criteria (fallbacks documented + verified).

sam: On alerts: propose paging when error-rate > 1% for 5m OR sustained p99 degradation > 30% over baseline for 10m. Non-paging for token-cost drift < 20% (just a ticket). Ops team: confirm.

oncall-bot: @maria @alex oncall rota updated: Tue-Fri primary = dylan, Sat-Sun primary = lena, backup = marcos. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/prod-cutover. :white_check_mark:

jess: Docs checklist update: SDK streaming example + runbook + troubleshooting FAQ. Also need legal blurb for billing backstop. Can someone from legal/finops paste the approved wording?

maria: I'll loop in finops/legal in the PR. Important: the billing backstop must include a perf-based opt-out for the pilot customers (email + credit), not an automatic refund. We need a comms template for customer success.

alex: For rollback criteria: revert traffic to pilot-only config if availability < 99% for 15m OR error-rate > 3% for 10m. Must be executable in < 5m via the cutover runbook. Adding a step-by-step revert snippet to the runbook.

sam: Quick note on monitoring retention: 14 days for detailed traces, 90 days for aggregated metrics. Is that ok w/ SRE? We need traces to debug regressions during the first 2 weeks.

oncall-bot: SRE confirmed longer retention for first 30 days for the pilot window. See runbook appendix.

jess: Who's doing the final QA signoff? Product should own acceptance, Eng signs off infra & SLA tests, SRE confirms observability, Legal/Finops must approve billing language. If we can get all checkboxes green by Mon EOD, we can schedule the cutover Wed morning.

maria: Proposed owners: Product = maria (acceptance), Eng = alex (SLA/tests + rollbacks), Infra/SRE = sam (monitoring + retention), Docs = jess (runbook + SDK), FinOps/Legal = TBD (billing backstop language). CS/AM = tbd for comms. Can we get volunteers on FinOps/CS?

alex: I'll ping finance on the billing backstop thread and cc product.

jess: I'll open PRs for the runbook + streaming SDK and tag reviewers. ETA Tue noon.

maria: OK — action items summary: 1) Alex: SLA test script & fallback doc; 2) Sam: dashboards + alerts mapping; 3) Jess: runbook + SDK + FAQ; 4) FinOps/Legal: billing backstop wording; 5) Ops: ensure oncall and revert play are runnable. If anyone can't meet their deliverable, flag here by EOD today. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: :thumbsup: will update status in channel when pushed.

sam: I'll start dashboard PR now.

jess: PRs opened: runbook (#412) and SDK examples (#413). Requests reviewers: @maria @alex @sam.

maria: Thanks — putting this on the shiproom agenda. Final check Friday morning.
